The Arboretum at Estancia La Constancia is a living, **33-hectare** botanical garden
with more than **30,000 plants** and **300 species**, in Mar del Plata. We welcome
visits **by advance booking**, so that each group enjoys a personalized, safe and
highly educational experience.

## How to visit us

Visits are arranged **by advance booking**. You write to us, together we define the
type of tour, the date and the details, and we confirm everything before the day.
Since these are outdoor activities, when booking we agree on a **main date and an
alternative** in case the weather does not cooperate.

## Before you come

To make the most of the outdoor tour, we recommend:

- 👟 **Comfortable, closed shoes** suitable for walking on natural trails.
- 🧢 **Sun protection**: cap, sunscreen and sunglasses.
- 💧 **Water** to stay hydrated during the walk.
- 🧥 **A jacket or windbreaker** depending on the season.
- <i class="bi bi-camera"></i> **A camera or binoculars** if you enjoy birdwatching.

## Frequently asked questions

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Do I need to book? How do I do it?"}
Yes, all visits are by advance booking. You can book from the
[experiences](experiences.html) page, complete the
[educational visits](educational-visits.html) form, or write to us directly by
email or WhatsApp (see below).
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="How long does the visit last?"}
It depends on the proposal: visits usually last **between 2 and 4 hours**. When
arranging the booking we define the duration according to the group and its goals.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="What happens if it rains?"}
When booking we agree on a **main date and an alternative**. If the weather does not
cooperate on the main day, we move to the backup date at no extra cost.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="How much does it cost?"}
The price depends on the **type of visit** and the **group size**. Write to us and we
will send you a tailored proposal.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Is there parking?"}
Yes, we coordinate access and parking when confirming your booking. If you are coming
by bus or van, let us know in advance so we can organize entry.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Is the tour accessible?"}
The arboretum is a natural environment with dirt and grass trails. If your group
includes people with reduced mobility, tell us when booking and we will adapt the
route as much as possible.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Can I bring my pet?"}
As this is a conservation area with native wildlife, please check with us before your
visit to learn the conditions.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Can I come with children?"}
Of course! We design experiences for all ages, from early years to adults. Tell us
the ages in the group and we will adapt the proposal.
:::
